versions.changelog:
- Added guidance on how to obtain a free API key, including an invite link.
- No changes to functionality or API—documentation only update.
- Version bumped to 1.0.1.

- Initial release of the Pincaimao Mock Interview skill.
- Simulate realistic multi-turn interview scenarios with support for text and video modes, custom questions, role settings (HR/professional), and optional reference answers.
- Requires PCM_MOCK_INTERVIEW_KEY for authentication; integrates with resume file uploads and contextual conversation management using conversation_id.
- Offers both default, user-friendly outputs and a raw output mode upon request.
- Includes Bash and Python examples, detailed parameter descriptions, and troubleshooting for common errors.
